auto_brandstorypage_88: The Swiss end is responsible for the development of innovative raw materials, method development, mechanism verification, human efficacy design and data specification in Europe;
auto_brandstorypage_89: The Chinese end is responsible for industrialization transformation and efficient delivery, forming a perfect closed-loop system that connects upstream innovation and downstream manufacturing.
auto_brandstorypage_91: Covering the design and mechanism research at the molecular/cellular level, supporting the iteration of core transdermal technology. Efficiently screen and optimize active molecules/functional raw materials based on AI deep learning.
auto_brandstorypage_93: The world's leading cTDP penetration-promoting mechanism solves the industry problem of difficulty for macromolecules to penetrate the dense "brick wall structure" of the stratum corneum, allowing active substances to take effect deep down.
auto_brandstorypage_95: Large-scale production from strain construction, fermentation amplification to purification and preparation forms a closed-loop capability from design to implementation to ensure stable mass production.
auto_brandstorypage_97: Cyclic peptides specifically bind to skin surface cell receptors
auto_brandstorypage_99: The tight junction structure on the surface of skin cells changes, forming a large gap in 5 minutes
auto_brandstorypage_101: Macromolecule active substances penetrate smoothly through the open intercellular space
auto_brandstorypage_103: After 15 minutes, the skin gap automatically returns to its normal barrier structure.
